domain-information: A Customer requests a moving quote to understand the expected cost of relocating their belongings.
A Customer schedules a moving date for the relocation as well as the locations for pick up and delivery.
A Move Coordinator assess a moving quote for a customer.
A Move Coordinator reviews the customer’s inventory list to determine the resources required for moving day.
A Move Coordinator assigns a moving crew to ensure all tasks are covered for the scheduled relocation.
A Packing Specialist logs each box before transit.
A Packing Specialist labels packed boxes so the delivery team can place them correctly at the new location.
A Driver assesses the route before departure.
A Driver updates the delivery status during the trip to keep the coordinator informed of progress.
A Crew Supervisor confirms the delivery with the customer once the relocation is completed.
A Crew Supervisor creates a report for the coordinator that summarizes the relocation services.

associations.description: Customer requests a Moving Quote to estimate the relocation
Move Coordinator reviews the Moving Quote for accuracy and approval
Customer schedules the Relocation for their move
Move Coordinator manages the details of the Relocation
Move Coordinator checks the Inventory List to plan resources
Move Coordinator assigns the Moving Crew to handle the relocation
Moving Crew carries out the tasks required for the Relocation
Move Coordinator oversees the Delivery stage of the relocation
Driver performs and updates the Delivery during transport
Driver follows the Route to complete the relocation
Packing Specialist prepares and labels each Box
Crew Supervisor creates the Relocation Report after the move
Relocation Report is submitted to the Move Coordinator for review
Crew Supervisor records the Delivery Confirmation with the customer
Customer acknowledges the Delivery Confirmation once the move is complete
